name: LAST SHELL
description: A shotgun loaded with hidden blank and live shells, passed around a table of up to 11 seats. Play hotseat with people, or seat up to 3 local agents — each with its own style, from reckless to sharp — and watch them reason out loud in the terminal beside the table. Agents see only what you see: the shell count, the public composition, and the spent tray. Never the order.
creator: altramanera
